verification: CI unit fixtures: pydantic settings over temporary config roots, httpx MockTransport and the real brain-api app through the Starlette test client; no deployed brain was contacted.
assertions: Default, personal and swarm configuration roots each produce an instance record that conforms to schemas/brain-instance-v2.json with its own brain id, configuration root, endpoint and policy revision.
A second independent fixture run produces the same records from its own roots.
brain-api GET /instance answers the configured brain id and policy revision without credentials and without vault paths or bearer values.
BrainClient verifies /instance with no Authorization header, then sends the bearer to /health; personal and swarm both bind.
Writing personal configuration and env files leaves every swarm file byte identical.
